'''2014 US Nationals Day 1 Nate Louderback LS Republic At War''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Nate Louderback]] at [[2014 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Republic At War / Aggressive Negotiations]]
* '''Username:''' dorshe1
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
